axes.model_access: Multi-model aggregation on the consumer side plus enterprise retrieval infrastructure. The official API docs list Search, Contents, Answer, Research, Finance Research and an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible Inference Router (2026-11-21).
axes.runtime: Consumer web (you.com) plus enterprise APIs; retrieval and generation run in the vendor cloud. The official API docs list Web Search, Contents, Answer, Research, Finance Research and Inference Router endpoints, split between ydc-index.io and api.you.com (2026-11-21).
axes.local_files: Chat history sits in the account cloud; the official APIs are request/response, with no local index or offline cache, returning structured JSON or Markdown. Official pages list no local data surface (2026-11-21).
axes.background: Q&A returns immediately; the Research API runs multiple searches, cross-references sources and synthesises within one request, making it a synchronous API rather than a pauseable job queue. Enterprise batch work must be queued by the caller (2026-11-21).
axes.tools: The consumer side has an answer engine, model switching and apps; the enterprise main axis is the Search API, Contents/Extract API, Answer API, Research API, Finance Research API and Inference Router, with endpoints and auth specified in the docs (2026-11-21).
axes.context: Consumer conversations are thread-based; enterprise APIs have no cross-request memory, so each request is independent and callers must carry context in the prompt. Cross-session memory is not listed officially (2026-11-21).
axes.permissions: Consumer accounts and subscriptions; enterprise contracts and API keys. Official docs require X-API-Key or Bearer auth, while training-use and retention follow the official terms and privacy page (2026-11-21).
axes.fit: Fit: evaluating enterprise retrieval infrastructure (Search/Research/Answer APIs) and consumer multi-model switching. Not fit: treating the consumer product as a long-term commitment (the centre of gravity has moved enterprise-side) or direct mainland access (measured 000) (2026-11-21).

runs: This entry checks the official site, terms and API docs for capability boundaries. ARI/Research retrieval quality, the consumer model list and free-tier limits need account-level measurement.

- Blog cadence: check the official changelog page.
